integrity: Exact combinatorial enumeration of all 720 vertex orders and 12 prism symmetries. An explicit free-face collapse to a graph gives an integral homotopy proof; signed chain traces give the rational character. Self-review only; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the full strong discrete-Morse matching complex of the unfilled triangular-prism graph is classified; neither other prism graphs nor the pure complex is addressed. The automorphism-module decomposition is over rational coefficients, not an integral lattice splitting. The exact finite certificate establishes the stated result for this graph but does not exclude equivalent unindexed prior work.
title: The strong Morse complex of the triangular prism: twenty-five circles and a prism-symmetry character
